uncertainties.front_end: Sixteen broad reddish circular end faces are visible. At the extreme right a seventeenth tile course runs against the foreground curved wing. Its hidden end ornament is not recorded. End faces are inset slightly in the dark lip. No stamped emblems are legible.
uncertainties.course_material: A convex terracotta cover and the concave pan between covers have distinct shingled seams. The dark loose double line crosses several courses and is excluded. The back-edge mortar and the small separate roof beyond the round wing are different features.
uncertainties.brackets: The vertical drop and their broad ochre faces are visible at the two eaves corners. The right extremity is screened by the curved wing. Their unobserved profiles are interpolated from the clearer left member.
